title: Deployments
description: Publish a version of the project to development or production. Every agent's and workflow's evals act as a gate before publishing.
readOnly: You have read-only access: you can see environments and history, but not publish or roll back.

noEnvironments.title: This project has no environments
noEnvironments.description: Development and production environments are created with the project. If they are missing, contact support.

logsDescription: Status, evals gate and full deployment log.
forcedHint: An admin published this version even though evals failed. It is recorded in the audit log.

development.label: Development
development.description: For testing with your team before it reaches users.

production.label: Production
production.description: The version used by your customers, interfaces, channels and the public API.

errors.deployment_in_progress: A deployment is already running in this environment. Wait for it to finish.
errors.force_requires_admin: Only an admin can force a deployment.
errors.not_rollbackable: You can only roll back to a version that was live.
errors.invalid_domain: That domain is not valid or belongs to the platform.
errors.domain_taken: That domain is already used by another environment.
errors.no_domain: This environment has no domain configured.
errors.dns_unavailable: We couldn't query DNS. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission for this action.
errors.not_found: We couldn't find it: it may have been deleted. Reload the page.

progress.title: {environment} · v{version}
progress.pollError: We couldn't refresh the deployment status. We'll retry automatically.

gate.title: Evals gate
gate.summaryFailed: {count, plural, one {# member failing} other {# members failing}}
gate.forcedThrough: The evals gate failed, but an admin forced the publication.
gate.blocked: The evals gate blocked the deployment. Fix the failing evals and publish again.
gate.skipped: Evals skipped: this rolls back to a version that already passed its gate when it was published.
gate.queued: Waiting for the deployment to start…
gate.running: Running every agent's and workflow's evals…
gate.noMembers: There are no agents or workflows to evaluate in this version.
gate.casesError: We couldn't load the cases of this eval run.
gate.casesMissing: We couldn't find the details of this eval run.

publish.title: Publish
publish.description: Choose the environment and the version. Ongoing conversations are not interrupted: new runs use the published version.

environmentHint.production: Customers, interfaces, channels and the public API.

publish.versionHint: A version is a snapshot of the whole project at a commit.
publish.latestHint: Snapshots the current code and publishes it.
publish.versionsError: We couldn't load previous versions; you can still publish the latest changes.
publish.messagePlaceholder: e.g. New tone for support answers
publish.gateExplanation: Every agent's and workflow's evals run before publishing. If any fails, the deployment is blocked and the environment keeps the previous version.
publish.forceHint: Admins only. Publishes the version even if the evals gate fails. It is recorded in the audit log.
publish.forceWarning: Evals still run, but their failures won't block the publication.

environment.emptyHint: Nothing has been published to {environment} yet.

domain.title: Custom domain
domain.inputHint: Use one of your subdomains, e.g. assistant.yourcompany.com. We'll give you the DNS records to create.
domain.invalid: Enter a valid domain, e.g. assistant.yourcompany.com.
domain.adminOnly: Only admins can change the domain.
domain.activeHint: The domain points to Messer and the TLS certificate is issued and renewed automatically.
domain.cnamePending: We verified that you own the domain. The CNAME record still has to point to Messer.
domain.recordsHint: Create these records at your DNS provider and press Verify.
domain.name: Name
domain.propagation: DNS changes can take from a few minutes up to 48 hours to propagate. Verify again later.
domain.verifyToSeeRecords: Press Verify to see the DNS records to create and check their status.
domain.pendingViewer: An admin is setting up this domain.
domain.removeDescription: {environment} will stop answering on this domain. You can add it again, but you'll have to verify it again.
domain.added: Domain {domain} added. Create the DNS records and verify it.
domain.verifiedOwnership: Ownership verified. The CNAME record is still missing.
domain.notYet: We can't see the DNS records yet. They may take a while to propagate.

history.title: History
history.description: Every publication with its version, commit, author and log.
history.error: We couldn't load the deployment history.

empty.title: Nothing published yet
empty.description: Publish a version so your users, interfaces and channels use it. Every deployment shows up here and you can go back to any previous version.

history.logsFor: View the log of v{version} in {environment}
history.rollbackDescription: Commit {commit} will be published again. Evals are skipped because this version already passed its gate. Ongoing conversations are not interrupted.
